policy_path.reason: Atlanta Fed MPT probability source; FRED proxy supplies short-rate path. FRED proxy (3m=DGS3MO; 6m=2*DGS6MO-DGS3MO; 12m=2*DGS1-DGS6MO) says hold: 6m 3.87 vs current policy 3.75. Fallbacks: DGS3MO missing, 3m uses current-to-2Y slope; DGS6MO missing, 6m uses current-to-2Y slope; DGS1 missing, 12m uses DGS2. This is a Treasury/front-end proxy, not futures pricing; the +/-25bp HOLD band allows for bill-vs-funds basis and term premium.
